name: rules.waterlevel

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive local currency match; repeat for alternatives. Acquisition always retains the full native scope.

get.description: Read all native configurations for one account alias; independent of current List row identities.

lookup.name: aliasName
lookup.description: Native account alias, available as List aliasName; never a bufferId.

result_identity.description: Each native configuration member has its own bufferId; preserve all members and versions.

purpose: Inspect native configuration through inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: bufferId
fields.meaning: Native string or integer row identity, retained without conversion.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account alias; distinct from bufferId.

limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. Native fields, nested values, exact decimals and unknown fields are retained.

List uses rowStart offsets with pageSize=5000 and null credit-date bounds. Native result.count is the coverage target; SDK collection reports duplicate identities, count shortfall and page gaps as incomplete.
Currency filters are exact local selections; acquisition retains the full native scope. Frontend account detail/version expansion is outside this List contract.

The qualified historical request width 5000 is a starting value, not a measured backend maximum. SDK conflict resolution keeps the last arrival and marks coverage incomplete; strict refresh preserves the prior cache on rejection.
Native Get is GET /bankAccountBufferListByAliasName.json with fixed tenant and aliasName lookup. It returns the entire native configuration array, including successful empty arrays.
Array member bufferId and aliasName are validated without choosing a version or synthesizing a root. Native versions, nested fields and order are preserved.
No same-object List binding: an account configuration array is different from the current List row. Get and --fields per-member projection never publish cache or Duckdog data.
